parsed.post: Discarding latest 0.8834: it still uses TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', which contains EVAL_SHARD=10 and leaks validation. Reverting to honest shards. Next: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' with depth 6, warmup 0.05, batch 262144 to re-baseline. Treat 0-10 sub-0.89 scores as contaminated.
parsed.description: Remove the validation-leak shard by training only on shards 0-9 while keeping depth 6, warmup 0.05, and batch size 262144.
